subject: Krypton capacity onboarding — milestones, burst ops & regional selection
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@krypton.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: Dedicated GPU pool onboarding (Krypton)

Hi Sergio / Redwood team,

Thanks for the demo last week — Krypton is ready to start provisioning dedicated capacity for our inference workloads. High level asks from our side:

- Target go-live window: mid-July (traffic ramp starting 2027-07-18)
- Initial pool: 12x A100 equivalent GPUs, region preference: us-west-2
- Autoscale with burst to additional 8 GPUs for 2-hour peak windows (spike protection)
- Strict data residency & audit log requirements (SOC-2 evidence will be requested)

Can we get an implementation plan with milestone owners, a short checklist for network/VPC peering, and a recommended burst policy? Also looping procurement (procurement@krypton.ai) for any contract-side gating.

Appreciate a POC-style mutual action plan we can share internally.

Best,
Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Platform
Krypton Systems

---

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@krypton.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Dedicated GPU pool onboarding (Krypton)

Alex — thanks for the clear scope. Attaching a concise diagram and a provisional milestones list to get us moving. Quick summary below and proposed owners:

- Milestone 1 (Week 1: 2027-06-14 to 2027-06-18): Network & security prep — owner: Monica Patel (CS/Implementation)
- Milestone 2 (Week 2: 2027-06-21 to 2027-06-25): Pool provisioning + initial test harness — owner: Karthik Iyer (Capacity Eng)
- Milestone 3 (Week 3: 2027-06-28 to 2027-07-02): Autoscale / burst policy tuning + canary traffic — owner: Ben Carter (SRE Liaison)
- Milestone 4 (Week 4: 2027-07-12 to 2027-07-18): Go/no-go + ramp to production — owner: Sergio Alvarez (CS Lead)

Provisional burst policy recommendation (short version):
- Burst windows: customer-defined scheduled windows + automated scale-on-spike up to 8 GPUs
- Pre-warm threshold: sustained 60% pooled token/sec for 45s triggers scale-up
- Cooldown: 10 minutes after median usage drops below 35%
- Fallbacks: route to smaller compatible model variant if capacity not available

I've attached "krypton_capacity_diagram.vsdx" and a provisioning checklist. Monica/Karthik — can you confirm VPC peering IP ranges and whether the customer will supply a NAT/egress gateway?

Sergio Alvarez
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: krypton_capacity_diagram.vsdx

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>

Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.j@krypton.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Dedicated GPU pool onboarding (Krypton)

Looping in some operational detail here so Alex/procurement know what we need to unblock provisioning: 

1) Network/VPC checklist (items you need to confirm):
   - VPC CIDR ranges for peering (please confirm exact subnets)
   - Public egress path & IP allowlist for monitoring endpoints (we provide a short list)
   - KMS/HSM key ownership model (customer-managed KMS or Redwood-managed)

2) Autoscale/burst policy questions:
   - Do you expect predictable scheduled peaks (daily/weekly) or unpredictable spikes?
   - If scheduled, provide preferred windows and expected concurrency profile (tokens/sec or QPS)

3) Compliance evidence timeline: we can upload SOC-2 artifacts to a secure share. Will you need a dedicated runbook for audit?

Action items for Krypton: confirm subnet CIDRs + whether you want Redwood-managed KMS. If Krypton needs a hard SLA on burst availability we should escalate to capacity planning early (that can change commitments/cost).

Thanks — I can own network coordination once we have the subnets.

Monica Patel
Implementation Lead, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@krypton.ai>

Subject: Re: Kickoff: Dedicated GPU pool onboarding (Krypton)

Thanks Monica — quick answers:

- We have predictable weekly batch peaks: Tuesdays 14:00–16:00 PT and Friday 09:00–11:00 PT. Expecting ~3x baseline QPS during those windows.
- Subnet CIDRs: 10.12.0.0/20 (application), 10.12.16.0/28 (peering endpoints). Full list attached in follow-up.
- KMS: Krypton will provide a customer-managed KMS key (we'll share ARN after procurement clearance).
- Compliance: please upload SOC-2 evidence to the secure link you mentioned; we'll need the runbook for our auditors by 2027-07-01.

Procurement: tagging you to confirm contract milestone dependencies and whether PO issuance will be needed before provisioning.

Alex
